metadata.scenario_context: James, Amy, and Lucas, who are colleagues at a technology startup, have recently been given the task to organize a company event to celebrate their startup's success in releasing their first app. The team has been buzzing about a recently published article claiming that the government is planning to lower corporate taxes which will greatly benefit their startup. They decide to discuss the details of the event

cultural_axis.agent_1_value: People from USA have a great deal of confidence in the press at all.
cultural_axis.agent_2_value: People from Tunisia have no confidence in the press at all.

agent_1.goal_1: Suggest a vegetarian-friendly place for the celebration.
agent_1.goal_2: Question whether  there is confidence in the press.

agent_2.goal_1: Discuss where to host the celebratory event.
agent_2.goal_2: Discuss whether there is confidence in the press.

shared_prefix.speaker: Lucas
shared_prefix.message: I think we should celebrate at that new vegetarian place downtown, I've heard great things about it. Plus, it's a good spot for a team event. What do you guys think, James?
shared_prefix.label: unrelated_topic

shared_prefix.speaker: James
shared_prefix.message: The new vegetarian place sounds okay, I guess. But have you seen the article about the government planning to lower corporate taxes? I'm not sure I believe it, I mean, we all know how reliable the press is... not. What's your take on that, Lucas?
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Lucas
shared_prefix.message: I think we can trust the press to get it mostly right, James. We both know, at the end of the day, that people are pretty much motivated by the same things, and the basic need to communicate is the same everywhere. When you really get to know people, they're pretty much like us, and some values are just universal. Let's not worry too much about the details, deep down, we are all the same, and I'm sure the article is just trying to get the story out there.
shared_prefix.label: Minimization

turns.speaker: James
turns.message: I don't know, Lucas... I've seen too many times where the press gets it wrong, especially back home. I just can't bring myself to trust them that much. Anyway, about the event, what do you think about having it at the park instead? It's more budget-friendly and we can have more space.
turns.label: Defense

turns.speaker: Lucas
turns.message: I understand your concerns, James, but I still believe the press does a good job. As for the event, I'm not sure about the park, it might be a bit too casual for a celebration of our app's success. The vegetarian place I mentioned earlier would be a nicer setting, don't you think? Plus, it's already set up for events like this, so it would be less hassle for us to organize.
turns.label: Acceptance

turns.speaker: James
turns.message: I see your point about the park, but I'm still not sold on the vegetarian place. How about we compromise and look into other venues that are a bit more... formal? And I'm telling you, Lucas, I just don't trust the press, I think they're always sensationalizing things.
turns.label: Defense

turns.speaker: Lucas
turns.message: I'm open to looking at other venues, James. But I have to say, I do trust the press to report the news accurately. I think they're doing their best to keep us informed, and we should give them the benefit of the doubt. Don't you think that's *fair*?
turns.label: Minimization

turns.speaker: James
turns.message: Fair? I don't think so, Lucas. The press has let me down too many times. I just can't trust them to get it right. Let's focus on the event, shall we? What about that new rooftop bar that just opened up? It's got a great view and could be a nice spot to celebrate.
